brand.name: daymark
brand.tagline: Tea for the pace you keep.
brand.voice: Warm, clear, and grounded. Write with sensory precision and everyday confidence; favor short sentences, active verbs, and useful details over tea jargon.

about: Daymark finds characterful loose-leaf teas for first light, full afternoons, and the quiet cup after dark. We source with the seasons, pack in small batches, and make every tea easy to choose without a tasting dictionary.

products.name: Daybreak
products.description: A bright, clean sencha with a lift of yuzu, tender greens, and a crisp mineral finish. Fresh enough to start the day, steady enough for a second steep.

products.name: Sidewalk
products.description: A brisk, honeyed black tea with ripe muscat fruit and a dry cedar finish. Clear and lively on its own, with enough structure for a little milk.

products.name: Night Shift
products.description: A naturally caffeine-free rooibos blend with cocoa warmth, soft vanilla, and a tart red-berry edge. Full flavored, calm, and made for late hours.

products.name: Open Road
products.description: A fragrant high-mountain oolong with stone-fruit sweetness, orchid lift, and a gently toasted finish. Its rolled leaves open across several generous steeps.
